loesungen.musterloesung: 1. went  2. didn't see  3. Did you enjoy

bewertungen.referenz_feedback: „go“ is irregular (went). After „did“ / „didn't“ use the base form: see, enjoy.
1 and 3 are correct. Negatives need „didn't“ + base form.

loesungen.musterloesung:
1. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
2. If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.

bewertungen.referenz_feedback: In the if-part there is no „will“ – and the main clause needs „will“.
Remember: if + simple present (it rains, you don't hurry), main clause with will.

loesungen.musterloesung: 1. False – she has a little brother. 2. True. 3. False – she doesn't like maths, her favourite subject is art.

bewertungen.referenz_feedback: The answers are right, but the false statements must be corrected.
1 is wrong: Emma has a brother, not a sister.
